A recent survey found that 92% of U.S. adults have delayed or avoided medical care due to high costs. 

Meanwhile, a new study from Yale estimates that Medicare for All would save over 114,000 lives and $1 trillion a year.

If this country was truly “pro-life,” we would have universal healthcare.

That way, they win everything — and they'll be able to take it all without the rest of us putting up a fight.

But please do not fall into cynicism.

I’ve been in or around politics for over a half-century now. 

I’ve watched as corporations and the super-rich flooded D.C. with campaign cash and ransacked our system. 

It won't be easy, but here’s how we break the corporate oligarchy and return power to the people.

We must get Big Money out of politics.
